## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | Research + interview thoroughness | Light (2 stakeholder, 0 customer) / Standard (5 stakeholder, 3 customer) / Deep (10 stakeholder, 8 customer) | Sprint pace blocks Deep |

| **Pace** | Calendar | Sprint (2 wks) / Standard (6 wks) / Extended (10 wks, includes leadership alignment) | Sprint blocks Deep + Full system |
| **Format** | Delivery format | Async docs only / Workshops + docs / Facilitated leadership sessions | Async-only blocks Extended (alignment work requires live sessions) |
| **Support** | Revisions + post-delivery | 1 round, no follow-up / 2 rounds + 30-day office hours / Unlimited-in-scope + 90-day office hours + implementation call | — |
| **Category Complexity** *(domain-specific)* | Positioning difficulty premium | Established category / Adjacent-to-known / Emerging or undefined | Emerging category blocks Sprint pace |
| **Audience Alignment** *(domain-specific)* | Who the brand needs to land with | Founder-only / Leadership team (adds alignment workshop) / Leadership + investors/board | Investor track requires Workshops+ Format minimum |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Full system breadth
- Naming/tagline without +Voice breadth
- Async-only format + Extended pace
- Async-only format + Leadership/Investor alignment

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Lite — Positioning Sprint · **$6,500**

- **Configuration:** Depth: Light · Breadth: Verbal-only · Pace: Sprint (2 wks) · Format: Workshops + docs · Support: 1 round · Category: Established · Audience: Founder-only
- **Positioning:** For founders who know what they do but can't articulate it — clean positioning + messaging pillars in two weeks, no full brand system.
- **Pricing logic:** ~43% of flagship; anchored against the cost of continuing to pitch with muddled positioning. Sits above one-off $2–4K "positioning intensives" because it includes stakeholder interviews and a workshop, not just a template call.

### Core — Brand Guide *(flagship)* · **$15,000**

- **Configuration:** Depth: Standard · Breadth: +Voice · Pace: Standard (6 wks) · Format: Workshops + docs · Support: 2 rounds + 30-day office hours · Category: Established or Adjacent · Audience: Founder or small leadership
- **Positioning:** For growth-stage companies ready for a real brand foundation — positioning, messaging, voice, and a compiled brand guide their team and vendors can actually use.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored at senior-strategist-solo pricing (~$15K) against agency brand engagements ($25–50K) that deliver comparable strategic output with more overhead. This is the flagship — the price the whole architecture pivots on.

### Premium — Brand System + Alignment · **$32,000**

- **Configuration:** Depth: Deep · Breadth: Full system · Pace: Extended (10 wks) · Format: Facilitated leadership sessions · Support: Unlimited-in-scope + 90-day office hours + implementation call · Category: any (incl. Emerging) · Audience: Leadership + investors/board optional
- **Positioning:** For funded companies naming/renaming, entering a new category, or needing leadership alignment before an agency handoff — full verbal system with executive alignment baked in.
- **Pricing logic:** Below the sum-of-parts (~$42K if built via BYO) and well below consultancy retainers ($50–75K) for equivalent naming + strategy + alignment scope. Rational discount vs. BYO; rational premium vs. Core given naming + leadership facilitation.

---

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard: **+$3,000** · Standard → Deep: **+$4,500**
- Breadth: Verbal → +Voice: **+$2,500** · +Voice → Full system: **+$5,500** (naming is the expensive atom)
- Pace: Sprint → Standard: **+$1,500** · Standard → Extended: **+$3,500**
- Format: Async → Workshops: **+$2,000** · Workshops → Facilitated leadership: **+$4,000**
- Support: 1 round → 2 rounds + 30d: **+$1,800** · → Unlimited + 90d + implementation: **+$3,500**
- Category Complexity: Emerging category surcharge: **+$3,000**
- Audience Alignment: Leadership team: **+$2,500** · Leadership + investors: **+$5,000**

**Floor:** $6,500 (Lite baseline; nothing sells below this)

**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, configurator auto-routes to Premium flat rate ($32K) or a custom-scope conversation

**Configurator must enforce all seven dependency rules from Part 2.**

**Flagship-protection check:**
- BYO to reach Core config = $6,500 + $3,000 (depth) + $2,500 (breadth) + $1,500 (pace) + $1,800 (support) = **$15,300** → flagship at $15,000 wins ✓
- BYO to reach Premium config = $6,500 + $3,000 + $4,500 + $2,500 + $5,500 + $1,500 + $3,500 + $2,000 + $4,000 + $3,500 + $2,500 = **~$39,000+** → flagship at $32,000 wins decisively ✓

Flagships remain the rational discount at every rung.

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Tier 1 — Foundation *(entry)*

### Tier 2 — Signature *(flagship)*

- **Positioning:** For clients who want real customization and a coach who actually watches their lifts — the sweet spot between DIY and full concierge.
- **Pricing logic:** **+$B/mo** — sits meaningfully below your current 1-on-1 rate while delivering ~80% of the perceived value; this is where you want most clients to land.

### Tier 3 — Elite *(concierge)*
- **Configuration:** Fully custom Depth · Training + Nutrition + Habits Breadth · Weekly pace · App + Async + Live calls Format · Voxer + video form review Support · Active Accountability
- **Positioning:** For clients who want a coach in daily orbit — high accountability, full lifestyle coaching, near-1-on-1 responsiveness.
- **Pricing logic:** **+$C/mo** — priced at or slightly above your current 1-on-1 rate; justified by Voxer + active accountability + habits layer that pure 1-on-1 doesn't include.

- **Base price:** +$A/mo (Foundation configuration)
- **Per-dimension upgrades:**
  - Depth → Fully custom: **+$D**
  - Breadth → +Nutrition: **+$E** · +Habits: **+$F**
  - Pace → Bi-weekly: **+$G** · Weekly: **+$H**
  - Format → +Live calls: **+$I/call or +$J/mo**
  - Support → 24hr + video review: **+$K** · Voxer: **+$L**

- **Floor:** +$A/mo — below this the coaching relationship doesn't function
- **Ceiling:** If BYO configuration sums above Elite price, auto-route to Elite (or custom quote if competition prep is selected)
- **Configurator enforces:** all dependencies in Part 2's block-list
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to reach Signature's exact configuration must price **~15–20% above** Signature's flagship price. BYO-summing to reach Elite must price **~20–25% above** Elite. Flagships remain the rational discount for clients who want the pre-built stack.

You're selling a **physical product**, not a service. Productization/modularization is about turning custom human labor into configurable packages. A wallet is already a finished, atomic unit — there's nothing to decompose into "deliverables + time blocks + access tiers."

What you likely want instead is one of these (different problem, different frame):

- **SKU/variant architecture** — offering the wallet in configurable variations (leather type, thread color, card slots, monogramming, size). This is product-variant design, not service productization.
- **Bundle logic** — wallet + cardholder + keychain at a bundled price vs. individual.
- **Tiered product lines** — a $60 "essentials" line, the $120 flagship, a $240 "heritage" line in exotic leather. This is line architecture, not service tiering.
- **Made-to-order configurator** — if you *do* offer customization (initials, custom layouts, bespoke commissions), then the *custom commission* portion is a service and this skill could apply to *that piece only*.

**Quick redirect:** if you want help with any of the above, tell me which — I'd point you to product-line or e-commerce merchandising frameworks, not this one.

**One exception where I could help:** if you also do **bespoke/commissioned wallets** (customer sends specs, you build to order), that commissioning process *is* a service and I can modularize it into tiers + build-your-own. Let me know if that's part of your business.

This is a **hybrid offering** — SaaS product ($99/mo, already modular as one fixed atom) + service (the $2,500 implementation). I'll decompose the service portion only. The SaaS subscription is a fixed line item that rides alongside every tier.

The free MIT skill stays free forever — that's the top of the funnel, not a tier. The tiers sit *above* it.

|---|---|---|---|
| **Clay Free** (unchanged, funnel) | Depth: Base · Breadth: JSON only · Support: Community · Access: Public · Governance: MIT · Human: None | For anyone kicking tires or hobbyist use. Same skill, forever free, MIT. | $0. Distribution engine, not revenue. Protects the "we're open-source" positioning. |
| **Clay Pro** *(entry paid)* | +Extended examples · +YAML/claude-mem emitters · Async office hours · Registered + newsletter · MIT + attribution · None | Solo consultants and coaches productizing their own book of business. | `+$A/yr` — anchored below one hour of the buyer's own consulting rate/month. Impulse-purchase price for an individual operator. |
| **Clay Studio** *(flagship)* | +Vertical presets + regression suite · All emitters + all memory adapters · SLA + named contact · Private channel + early access · Commercial license · Async review credits (e.g., 4/yr) | Agencies and boutique firms productizing multiple service lines, or coaches with team/associates. | `+$B/yr` — anchored below the cost of one botched productization engagement (typically 1–3 months of misaligned tiering). Should feel like insurance, not software. |
| **Clay Enterprise / White-Label** | Everything in Studio · Dedicated engineer · Slack Connect · White-label + resale rights · Embedded advisor · Custom vertical preset build included | Platforms, incubators, VC portfolios, and mid-market consultancies who want to ship Clay *to their own* clients under their brand. | `+$C/yr` — anchored against the cost of building an equivalent internal capability (1 senior product strategist FTE ≈ $200K+ loaded). Priced as a fraction of that. |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** Clay Pro (`+$A/yr`) — the floor for any paid config
- **Per-dimension upgrades:**
  - Depth: Base → Extended `+$a1` · Extended → Presets+Suite `+$a2`
  - Breadth: JSON → +YAML/claude-mem `+$b1` · → All emitters/adapters `+$b2`
  - Support: Community → Office hours (included in Pro) · → SLA `+$c1` · → Dedicated `+$c2`
  - Access: Public → Registered (included in Pro) · → Private+early `+$d1` · → Slack Connect `+$d2`
  - Governance: MIT+attribution (Pro) → Commercial `+$e1` · → White-label/resale `+$e2`
  - Human-in-loop: None → Review credits `+$f1` · → Live sessions `+$f2` · → Embedded advisor `+$f3`
  - Add-ons: Blueprint review call `+$g1` · Custom vertical preset `+$g2` · Re-clay retainer `+$g3/qtr`

- **Floor:** `+$A/yr` (Clay Pro). Nothing paid ships below this — free tier catches everything cheaper.

- **Ceiling:** Any config exceeding ~80% of Enterprise price auto-routes to Enterprise (bundled cheaper). Any request for white-label OR dedicated engineer OR custom preset build auto-routes to Enterprise sales conversation.

- **Configurator must enforce:**
  - White-label ⇒ Commercial+resale governance ⇒ Enterprise tier
  - SLA ⇒ Registered access minimum
  - Live sessions ⇒ SLA support minimum
  - Custom preset build ⇒ Commercial license minimum
  - No paid config below Pro floor

- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to Clay Studio's configuration must exceed Studio's flagship price by ≥25%. Specifically: `a1 + a2 + b1 + b2 + c1 + d1 + e1 + f1 (credits) > +$B × 1.25`. Same test for Enterprise vs. its BYO sum. Studio and Enterprise must remain the rational discount; BYO is for operators whose needs genuinely don't map to a tier.
